props.eyebrow: Wedding and event music at a Boulder hotel
props.title: St Julien Hotel & Spa
props.lede: St Julien is in downtown Boulder, a block off Pearl Street, and its lawn and terraces look straight up at the Flatirons.

headingText.html: Live music is part of the hotel already. There are bands on the terrace from Wednesday to Saturday, and jazz at the holiday buffets.

props.title: Live music in each St Julien Hotel & Spa event space
props.lede: Here’s the act we’d pick for each space. Press play to hear it over the photo.

spaces.name: The lawn
spaces.facts: The lawn is about 2,400 sq ft of grass with views of the Flatirons, for banquets of up to 200 and receptions of up to 275.
spaces.why: A solo violin to a full string quartet, from the ceremony through dinner.
spaces.alt: The lawn set with rows of white ceremony chairs, seen from above, with terraced gardens behind.

spaces.name: Xanadu Ballroom
spaces.facts: The Xanadu Ballroom is about 4,100 sq ft with 14-foot ceilings, for banquets of up to 300 and receptions of up to 360. It divides into three, and there’s about 2,900 sq ft of pre-function space outside.
spaces.why: He can start as a duo and grow to a full band over the evening.
spaces.alt: The Xanadu Ballroom set for a wedding reception, with candlelit tables around a dance floor and a band stage lit in blue.

spaces.name: Redgarden terraces and court
spaces.facts: The Redgarden Lower Terrace holds dinners of up to 80, and the Redgarden Court and Upper Terrace hold receptions of up to 100 and 75.
spaces.why: His own folk and Americana songs on acoustic guitar, solo or with his band.
spaces.alt: A stone terrace at dusk with cocktail tables and a hedge, and the Flatirons on the skyline.

spaces.name: Jill’s and the Honey Onyx Room
spaces.facts: Jill’s, the hotel’s restaurant, holds private events of up to 140, and the Honey Onyx Room holds up to 40.
spaces.why: Upright bass and guitar, at a volume nobody has to raise their voice over.

props.title: Planning music at St Julien Hotel & Spa

rows.text: Our acts bring their own sound system, sized to the space. The hotel also has AV in-house.
The hotel’s garage has a 7-foot height limit, so we plan where the act parks and unloads ahead of time.
The hotel caters events in-house, and it has its own wedding specialist.
The terrace has bands from Wednesday to Saturday, so we’ll plan your music around it.
Boulder limits amplified sound outdoors late at night, so an outdoor event wraps up its loud music and moves inside.
The lawn and terraces are outdoors, so we’ll plan the music with an indoor backup in mind.

props.html: Questions to ask the St Julien Hotel & Spa events team

items.html: Which spaces have an end time for amplified music, and when is it?
Does the hotel’s AV team need to connect or run the band’s sound, and is there a fee for that?
Where do vendors load in, and when can the band set up?
Is there power near where the band will play?
What wording do you need on the certificate of insurance?

props.html: Forward this list to the events team, or send us the answers and we’ll plan around them.
Questions about music at St Julien Hotel & Spa

items.q: Can we bring our own band to a wedding at St Julien Hotel & Spa?
items.a: Hotels like St Julien Hotel & Spa generally let you book your own entertainment, within their rules on insurance, load-in and sound. Your event manager can confirm them for your date, and we send a certificate of insurance with every booking.

items.q: Does the band need the hotel’s AV team?
items.a: Our acts bring their own sound system, sized to the space. The hotel’s AV team can add anything beyond that, and we’ll work out the details with your event manager.

items.q: Can one act play the ceremony, the cocktail hour and the reception?
items.a: Yes. The same act can move with you from The lawn to The Redgarden terraces to The Xanadu Ballroom, and one booking covers all of it.

items.q: How much does live music add to a wedding at St Julien Hotel & Spa?
items.a: It depends on the size of the act and how much of the day it covers. Our pricing page has what live music costs in the Colorado market, and we’ll send a quote for your date.
